strategic_verdict.strongest_module: HPLC Kinetic & Chromatographic Method Development Engine (hplc_simulator_script.js)
strategic_verdict.strongest_paper_concept: Concept B: An Open-Access, Interactive In Silico HPLC Simulation Platform for Gradient Method Development and Pedagogical Fault Injection in Pharmaceutical Analysis (Target: Journal of Chemical Education, $0 APC)
minimum_viable_work: 1. Freeze baseline code (do not refactor or rebuild).
2. Benchmark simulated retention times against 5 published experimental mixtures on C18 columns.
3. Compute RMSE, R^2, and MAPE between simulated and real chromatograms.
4. Conduct a 1-day student evaluation workshop (N=30) measuring pre/post diagnostic troubleshooting scores on fault injection scenarios.
5. Draft manuscript targeted for Journal of Chemical Education (ACS) with $0 traditional author fee.
